##### Project general facts

Mira Ocean Estates Phase 1 unveils itself as Oman's first multi-branded beachfront community, an extraordinary development that brings together fully furnished apartments, villas, and townhouses on the pristine shores of the Arabian Sea. This visionary community offers a curated selection of branded residences, including Richmond Residences and Trussardi Residences, alongside mansions, villas, townhouses, and residential apartments, all designed to cater to every way of living. With a five-star hotel, medical clinic, gym and spa, swimming pool, beach club, and private beach access, this is a resort you never have to leave — a fully integrated coastal community where every desire is anticipated and every need is fulfilled.

The residences at Mira Ocean Estates Phase 1 are surrounded by quality, featuring natural stone, rich textures, designer furniture, and premium appliances that elevate everyday living to new heights of sophistication and comfort. Each home has been meticulously crafted to offer a harmonious blend of elegance and functionality, where the beauty of natural materials and the finest finishes create spaces that are both inviting and inspiring. The water is never far, with private beach access, open coastal views, and a central swimming pool all within easy reach, ensuring that the serenity of the Arabian Sea is always part of daily life.

Beyond the exquisite residences, Mira Ocean Estates Phase 1 offers an unparalleled array of amenities that cater to every aspect of modern living. Residents enjoy a magnificent central swimming pool, private beach access, a vibrant beach club, a state-of-the-art gym, a medical wellness centre, and a luxurious spa, all complemented by walking paths and outdoor playgrounds. The five-star hotel brings more ways to enjoy time close to home, from fine dining and private events to afternoons by the pool or beach, while diagnostics, wellness check-ups, and recovery facilities make it easier than ever to look after yourself close to home.

##### Location description and benefits

Salalah, Oman offers an idyllic setting on the Middle East's greenest coast, a year-round tourism destination renowned for its lush landscapes, seasonal waterfalls, long beaches, and warm coastal climate that captivates visitors and residents alike. This enchanting city, situated directly on the Indian Ocean, welcomes more than one million visitors annually with an average stay of nearly six nights, drawn by its natural beauty and the spectacular khareef season that transforms the region into a verdant paradise. The city's strategic location and growing reputation as a premier coastal destination make it an exceptional choice for those seeking a lifestyle of tranquility, natural beauty, and refined living.

Life within Salalah is defined by its exceptional connectivity and growing international appeal, with Salalah International Airport just thirty minutes away and direct connections through fifteen airlines serving seventeen destinations. The city's long-term growth potential is underpinned by Oman Vision 2040, a national strategy that supports sustainable development, economic diversification, and enhanced quality of life for residents and visitors alike. The area's low-tax environment, with no inheritance tax, and the availability of freehold ownership for foreign buyers, including a renewable two-year residence visa, make this coastal haven both accessible and exclusive.

The surroundings of Salalah offer a wealth of attractions and experiences that cater to every interest and lifestyle, from the pristine beaches and crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Sea to the breathtaking mountains, waterfalls, and archaeological sites that tell the story of this ancient and enchanting region. The neighbourhood's double-digit residential price growth year-on-year reflects the increasing desirability of this exceptional destination, where natural beauty and modern convenience converge in perfect harmony. This distinguished address truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the serenity of beachfront living with the dynamic allure of one of the region's fastest-growing and most captivating destinations.
